title: Add installer failure handling and recovery

context.summary: Add installer locking, diagnostics, journal persistence and recovery command surfaces.
context.background: Bootstrap and wizard entrypoints exist, but interrupted or failed installs need clear diagnostics, single-run locking and resume/repair surfaces before a real executor is added.

in: Add install lock primitives under MINDORY_HOME/install.
Add CLI resume and repair command surfaces.
Add SIGINT/SIGTERM cleanup handling for installer CLI and bootstrap scripts.
out: Full resume execution of an interrupted install plan.

acceptance_criteria: Installer core can acquire/release a lock under MINDORY_HOME/install and reject concurrent runs.
Installer core can persist/read a transaction journal.
Rollback validator covers failed rollback outcomes.
CLI exposes resume and repair commands with clear diagnostics.
Bootstrap scripts print clear interrupted/failed messages and stop further steps.

manual_checks: Confirm no full install executor or dependency auto-install is added.

risks: Lock handling must not delete arbitrary user data.
Recovery commands should be explicit that full resume execution is a later task.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
